content: go.etcd.io/bbolt v1.5.0 (published Jun 3 2026). Embedded B+tree key-value store. Single writer, multiple concurrent readers. Auto-incrementing sequences (NextSequence()) for ordered chat message IDs. Byte-sorted keys enable sequential scans. Nested buckets model maps naturally to sessions. For simple append-only sequential chat logs, adds complexity (bucket/serialization setup) vs JSONL with no benefit.
